title: Ghost by muneeb141 on the main branch from commit c731cdf through commit 672dfec contains an authentication bypass…
description: Ghost by muneeb141 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the whitelisted method ghost.api.ghost.convert_to_real_user. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to skip OTP verification by setting a client-supplied bypass_otp parameter. Attackers can first obtain a ghost session via the guest-accessible create_ghost_session endpoint, then call convert_to_real_user with an arbitrary real_email and bypass_otp=1 to receive OAuth tokens for existing accounts and take them over.
